facts.business: Uniinfo Telecom Services Limited provides contractual technical services relating to installation, testing, and commissioning for clients in telecom, EV charging infrastructure development, and e-surveillance.
key_risks: Accuracy of revenue recognition and estimation of work-in-progress in respect of onerous obligations on service contracts involves significant judgment
High inherent uncertainties in estimating work-in-progress under various contracts
Significant judgment required in estimating cost to complete and amount of variation orders to be recognized
